question.problem: Let ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14275468/assets/2501c175aa25fd5d70af201c3bd0788da58b674c5782984e06a089a4447299a1.svg) and ![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/differential/14275468/assets/f455effab674ae3ee3a0c2b0773c011735f3d3885a1c392b0233b7c5d164ee9b.svg) Find the orthogonal projection of $\mathbf{a}$ onto $\text{Span}\{\mathbf{b}\}.$
question.worked_solution:
The orthogonal projection of $\mathbf{a}$ onto $\textrm{Span}\{\mathbf{b}\}$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{b}\,a & =\frac{b\cdot a}{b\cdot b}b \\  & =\frac{2\cdot 2+1\cdot 9+0\cdot (-1)+1\cdot (-1)}{{2}^{2}+{1}^{2}+{0}^{2}+{1}^{2}}b \\  & =\frac{4+9+0-1}{4+1+0+1}b \\  & =\frac{12}{6}b \\  & =2b \\  & =2[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}4 \\ 2 \\ 0 \\ 2\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
